report.markdown:
# Daily report — 2026-11-02

**SYNTHETIC DATA · AI OFFLINE · NO TRADING · SAFE MODE**

**Data:** Synthetic demo data: numbers show how the system works, not real performance.

**AI:** No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set: Supervisor review and report use built-in templates.

## Verdict
